meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'playwright', 'flaky test', 'fails intermittently', 'passes in isolation', 'only fails in CI'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位并修复各类运行时故障，从崩溃到内存泄漏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常遭遇崩溃、泄漏或莫名失败却难以定位根因。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix any runtime failure, from crashes to memory leaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face crashes, leaks, or unexplained failures and can't find the root cause.

howto.what: Claude会进入“提假设、找证据”的排查模式:先读技能附带手册,同时验证至少3种可能原因,连败两轮就换角度重查。确认病根后,先用一条失败测试把问题钉死,再做最小修复,最后实际运行一遍验收,收尾时清掉全部调试痕迹。
howto.when: 当你说“debug this”“hanging”“why is X not working”等,或要求挂调试器、逆向分析时会触发;也适用任何语言与二进制的运行时故障,比如崩溃、静默失败、内存泄漏等。

say.text: 这个接口返回200但内容是空的,帮我查为什么。
say.note: 会先提假设再验证,不凭读代码猜。

say.text: 程序跑几分钟就卡死,像是内存泄漏,帮我找出根因。
say.note: 修复前会用失败测试把根因钉死。

say.text: 复现并修复这个bug,修完加一条防回归测试。
say.note: 先写失败测试再最小修复,避免跑偏。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a hypothesis-driven debug loop: reads its references first, forms ≥3 hypotheses, spawns Oracles after 2 failed rounds, confirms root cause, locks with a failing test, minimal fix, QA by using the system, scrubs artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'debug this', 'hanging', 'why is X not working', or attach/reverse-engineer requests. For any real runtime failure in any language — crashes, silent failures, leaks, etc.

say_en.text: This endpoint returns HTTP 200 but the body is empty. Debug why.
say_en.note: Hypothesis-first: it won't fix until the cause is confirmed.

say_en.text: Process hangs and memory grows — looks like a leak. Find the root cause.
say_en.note: It will lock the cause with a failing test before fixing.

say_en.text: Reproduce this bug and fix it, then add a regression test so it stays fixed.
say_en.note: A failing test comes first, then a minimal fix.
